Pasti .stx format preserves the codewheel copy-protection sectors. Original 1991 Atari ST release alongside the Amiga. Extractor implemented (extractors/atari_st_pasti.py): walks the Pasti track records, reconstructs a flat 720 KiB .st image per disk, then parses FAT12. Yields 16 files: BANK01..BANK0D (12 unique banks across the two disks, with BANK06 and BANK09 byte-identical between disks) plus START.PRG and AUTO/START.PRG. There is no memlist.bin on the floppies — the resource directory is embedded in START.PRG. Mapping these bank files back to the canonical AW resource indices is future work; the format matches the Amiga generation (Motorola 68000 engine).
European cartridge dump, zipped. Memory layout differs from USA — the AWVM_Tools snes branch is wired for the USA ROM.

Not yet fetched. Canonical filename per AWVM_Tools releases/snes/snes.py: `Out of This World (USA).sfc`. The chunk offsets in the romset extractor (0x74A4C, 0x81CB0) target this USA ROM specifically. Survey 2026-04-30 (agent A): no clean standalone item with a redistributable URL was located on archive.org — only a Fast-ROM+SRAM hack (out-of-this-world-aka-another-world-fast-rom-sramv-1.0-snes) and a 687-MB bundled snes100 zip with no separable per-file checksums. Recommend sourcing the No-Intro DAT-listed pristine cart from elsewhere and verifying by checksum before adding to the archive. Hidden Palace's Sep 1992 SNES prototype may be a separate variant worth a parallel slug.

ZIP at original_files/f15f23e1e0fa8d827c4b045d7ce3cf90/ contains `Another World (Europe).md` (1 MiB cartridge dump). Verified end-to-end via the Rust pipeline: all 7 levels' .asm output is byte-identical to the Python reference.

release: Heart of the Alien: Out of This World Parts I and II (SEGA CD, USA)
note: Bundles the original Out of This World with its only sequel, Heart of the Alien (Sega CD exclusive). Original-half is reportedly identical to the Genesis version with music+sfx differences. Sample CRC32 c524515e MD5 b96a4f8b4981a9ffabb2c3d9f381b33b for Track 01.bin (cdromance, unverified). Redump-grade dump on archive.org but item is stream-only — actual bin/cue download requires a different mirror (myabandonware, emuparadise, romhustler all carry it).

Redump-sourced 3DO CD-ROM (.bin/.cue pair, ~386 MiB), uploaded to archive.org by user `bikerspade` 2021-12-23. Also documented at https://tcrf.net/Out_of_This_World_(3DO). Opera FS extractor implemented (extractors/three_do_opera.py via the AWVM_Tools `opera-list` Rust binary) — yields 423 on-disc files including GameData/FileN, EndShape1/2, song1..30, plus AIFF audio in StalData/. Mapping these on-disc files back to the canonical AW resource indices remains future work.

Direct port from the SNES build (same 65C816 microprocessor — only such cross-port). WOZ flux-level disk images preserved by 4am (canonical Apple II preservation curator) in the woz-a-day collection on archive.org, uploaded 2021-06-01. Two disks (~1.27 MB each). archive.org metadata API confirms md5 + sha1 per file. A separate European IIgs item (e2gs_Out_of_this_World_Disk_1 / _Disk_2) exists on archive.org as smaller .po (ProDOS-order) images without per-file checksums — would warrant a parallel slug as the European variant.

Highest-quality canonical source: Macintosh Garden item. Per-file SHA-1 published; md5 of the .sit file confirmed at 411cfe55f7c43c7d846fcb2f24adeddb after fetch (3,739,614 bytes — the previous 3,744,000 figure was approximate). Architecture: Motorola 68k. Min specs: 2 MB RAM, System 6.0.7, 256 colors, hard disk. Same page also lists Out_of_this_World_1.0.mar (Disk Copy 4.2 v1.0 image, md5 6af682496d25ccee89e590f5843a6c78) and OutofthisWorldDemo.sit (md5 f080493b920a0a60da9f04ba424db7ae) — neither fetched yet, would warrant separate slugs as v1.0-only and demo variants. Two later community ports also live on the same page (Another_World_SDL_Intel.dmg PowerPC, anotherworldx_v0.2b.dmg) and are NOT the original 1993 release.

release: Another World (Atari Jaguar — Removers community port)
developer: The Removers (Jagware), authorised by Eric Chahi
note: Atari Jaguar never received a commercial Another World release; this is the authorised community port (engine rewritten for the Jaguar). Two graphical variants: original 16-color and 'Deluxe' 256-color 15th-anniversary. Sold as a physical cartridge with box & manual. Survey 2026-04-30 (agent B): no public ROM dump exists. Sole legitimate source is The Removers' commercial pre-order page at http://mleguludec.free.fr/product/AnotherWorld_Jaguar/ (still live); Atarimania's catalog lists Dump status as MISSING. Year of primary release per Atarimania is 2013 (sources vary 2013–2015); slug retained as `-2014` for stability. Wayback of the project page: https://web.archive.org/web/20250221073415/http://removers.free.fr/AnotherWorld/ . Acquiring this fixture will require a donor cartridge dump.

developer: Cyril Cogordan, reverse-engineered from the Atari ST version
note: Filename in AWVM_Tools releases/gba_usa: 'Another World (Prototype) # GBA.GBA'. Despite the 'Prototype' label, this is NOT a leaked Nintendo prototype — it's the Cyril 'Foxy' Cogordan fan port. Development started 2004; the public v2.1 release was 2005-04-28 (initially without authorisation; Eric Chahi authorised distribution in 2005, and is also credited with co-developing and remastering the music). Both author hosts (foxysofts.com, playerAdvance.org) are now defunct. Fetched from the OpenEmu-Update GitHub mirror; an identical-size copy exists at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/retrobrews/gba-games/master/anotherworld.gba . The slug 'gba_usa' in AWVM_Tools and the 'Prototype' filename are both misnomers and could be cleaned up post-port.

developer: Alekmaul, GBATemp 2011 Homebrew Bounty winner; based on the New RAW engine
note: Homebrew DS port — not Nintendo IP. Distributed openly on GBATemp. The original mirror (filetrip.net/files/f/25675-anotherworldDSV10.zip) is dead in 2026; only the Wayback snapshot at 2023-05-15 still serves the zip (1,136,040 bytes; md5 a819d702799090b198a887e458703517). Zip contains anotherworldDSV10.nds + a `wheel/` directory of 25 codewheel JPEGs (posn01.jpg..posn25.jpg, datestamped 2004 — likely sourced from the Atari ST manual's protection wheel). Requires user-supplied DOS bank01..bankNN + memlist.bin (English version) at runtime.

AWVM_Tools releases/symbian_demo expects `locked_anotherworld.sis`. The 'locked_' prefix is a specific cracked / DRM-stripped variant. Not yet found on a public mirror. Generic `anotherworld.sis` (Series 60 1st/2nd Edition, ~450 KB) is widely listed (mobiles24.co, vatikag.com, blogspot S60 catalogues) but offsets in AWVM_Tools' extractor are tuned for the specific locked dump (zlib payload at 0xBBA + 749540 bytes containing LZMA1 chunks). MD5/SHA1/CRC32 from comments in symbian2romset.py.

Compatible with Nokia 3230, 3250, 3600, 3620, 3650, 3660, 5500, 6260, 6600, 6620, 6630, 6670, 6680, 6681, 6682, 7610, 7650, N70, N71, N72. Confirmed DISTINCT from the locked variant: this fixture's md5 (a0012563536c4baaa6487031e00d7b0f) ≠ the locked-variant md5 (fe4742b67415eb16ef340548573538b8). File is 753,982 bytes (~736 KB) — larger than the ~450 KB initially documented; possibly a different (later or repacked) build. Sibling listing at mobiles24 (https://www.mobiles24.co/downloads/s/110775-307-another_world, also live, 752,492 bytes) is yet another distinct user upload — a plausible separate variant. Other documented Symbian variants worth tracking: Telcogames v1.25 SyMPDA-cracked SIS bundled inside Nokia_Games_Ultimate_SIS_Pack.zip on archive.org, and v1.36 inside the club-60-part-1-1-300 RAR collections. UIQ2 (Sony Ericsson P800/P900) is a distinct port — would warrant a separate slug.

release: Out of This World (Apple II 8-bit demake)
